*Sanidassanattika, Āsavāsavagocchakādi* (Patthana 10.14) is a canonical Abhidhamma text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna* collection of the Pali Tipiṭaka. Structurally situated within the combinatorial frameworks of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the work investigates the conditional relations between dhammas by conjoining the *sanidassanattika* (the triad of states with or without visible form and reactivity) with the *āsavagocchaka* and associated dyads pertaining to the taints or corruptions.
